text:
maya: Heads-up — we need alignment on the quieting schema + telemetry consumers before the SLO rollout. Observability flagged missing fields in notify-preview that we rely on for dashboards. Anyone free to sync?

alex: Which fields are missing?

maya: We expect quiet_window.start,end,scope,reason,owner but preview only has start/end + id. Example payload we saw: `{\"quiet_window\":{\"start\":\"2025-03-25T10:00Z\",\"end\":\"2025-03-25T12:00Z\",\"id\":\"q-123\"}}` — no scope/owner/hash.

taylor: That's because notify-preview API uses a compact proto to keep bandwidth down. We intentionally dropped owner for PII. We can include owner_id hashed instead.

jen: Console needs owner for handoff. Oncall wants a visible contact to route if the quiet is blocking needed alerts. Maybe owner_display_name + owner_email optional?

sam: Telemetry consumer needs a stable key (quiet_hash) to map alerts -> quiet windows. Right now dashboards key by quiet_id but staging preview sometimes emits transient IDs. Hash works better for joins.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI patch pushed to staging: notify-preview v1.2.3 — will roll back if errors.

alex: Proposal: change notify-preview to include `quiet_meta: {id, scope, hash, owner_display, reason_short}` — owner_display optional, backwards compatible.

taylor: API change seems ok. Bandwidth impact minimal; typical payload stays <1.5KB. We should keep fields short (no long bios).

maya: Also add sampling tags: telemetry needs `slo_id` and `routing_policy` to correlate noise-tuning work. e.g. tags:["slo:latency_95","route:primary"]

jen: Acceptance criteria I'm tracking: 1) console surfaces owner if present, 2) telemetry receives `quiet_hash` + `slo_id`, 3) docs/SDKs updated, 4) migration gate for Dedicated customers (no PII leak).

sam: I'll update the metrics consumer. Dashboards will accept `quiet_hash` as fallback when `quiet_id` is unstable.

alex: I'll write a short RFC + PR for console changes. Quick naming Q: prefer `owner_name` or `owner_display`? Keep consistent with other APIs.

maya: `owner_display` matches existing `applier_display` we use elsewhere, so :+1:. Also include `applied_by` to show who created the quiet.

taylor: I'll draft the proto change. Snippet:

```message QuietMeta {
  string id = 1;
  string scope = 2; // tenant|route|global
  string hash = 3; // stable join key
  optional string owner_display = 4;
  optional string reason = 5;
}

message NotifyPreview {
  QuietMeta quiet = 1;
  repeated string tags = 2; // e.g. slo_id, route
}```

jen: Can we add a soft-consent flag so `owner_display` is only shown when consented? If that's heavy, we'll gate in docs / Dedicated migration.

maya: For now show display name; security review will flag if needed. Rolling plan: taylor implements proto, alex RFC + console wiring, sam updates telemetry, QA on staging next Tue.

ops-bot: calendar-bot: Event created — "SLO Quieting Telemetry Staging QA" — 2025-03-25 10:00 UTC.

alex: I'll ping security for PII review. If we only send display names (no emails) should be low-risk.

jen: One more ask: provide an example telemetry event for `quiet_applied` with fields: `quiet_id`, `quiet_hash`, `slo_id`, `owner_display`, `applied_by`, `reason`. Sam confirm?

sam: Confirmed. Will accept both `quiet_id` and `quiet_hash`. Mapping logic I plan: `if (event.quiet_id) use id else use hashFallback(event.hash)` — will add migration shim in dashboards.

maya: Great. If no objections I'll create tickets for API, console, telemetry, docs.

alex: :+1: no objections from me.

jen: LGTM.

maya: Thanks all — I'll open tickets and link them to the RFC.

alex: I'll drop a short PR for the console show/hide logic once the proto is ready.
